the Gemara's own voice: ואפילו בקמייתא? ורמינהו

props.gloss_en: the mishnah: what is the order of fasts? they take the ark out to the city square
the baraita: on the first and second three fasts they enter the synagogue and pray as they pray all year
and on the last seven they take the ark out to the city square and put ashes on the ark, on the head of the Nasi and of the av beit din, and each one takes and puts [ashes] on his own head
R' Natan: they bring burnt ashes
Rav Pappa: when we learned the mishnah too, it was the last seven that we learned it of

objections.gloss_en: ואפילו בקמייתא? ורמינהו: the mishnah's ark ritual is unqualified, but the baraita has the first and second sets pray in the synagogue as all year, and the ark taken out only on the last seven
